name: sub_reset_thunk
comment: CLC / XCE / JMP $80:8000 - enters native mode and jumps to the FastROM mirror

name: sub_nmi
comment: native NMI vector target; not yet analysed

name: dat_cart_header_ext
comment: extended header: maker code 01, game code CG

name: dat_cart_header
comment: title, map mode $30, cart type $02, checksum $EEAE

name: tbl_vectors
comment: native + emulation vector tables; only NMI and emulation RESET are used

name: ram_sram_courses_cleared
comment: save slot (X = slot offset, 0 for the first member): courses cleared. Read by $81:FB9C into ram_courses_cleared

name: ram_sram_progress_flags
comment: save slot flags; bit $04 lets ram_courses_cleared reach 8 (all cleared), bit $08 is the extra-game equivalent ($81:FBB7)

name: ram_sram_medals
comment: save slot (X = slot x 64): medal value (low 2 bits) of each course, every 4 bytes: 8 normal courses, then 8 extra. Read by sub_medal_flags. A course 1 cleared by tools/snesstep/autoplay.py stores 3

name: ram_joy_held
comment: joypad 1 buttons held, read by $80:82D3 with D=0 (emulated)

name: ram_joy_repeat
comment: joypad 1 with auto-repeat (emulated)

name: ram_joy_pressed
comment: joypad 1 newly pressed this frame (emulated)

name: ram_cgram_stage
comment: CGRAM staging image; BG palettes at +$000, OBJ (sprite) palettes at +$100. DMA'd by sub_dma_cgram

name: ram_oam_buffer
comment: OAM buffer (low table $0600, high $0800); DMA'd to OAM by $80:82CA in NMI

name: ram_obj_list_head
comment: head of the active object linked list; negative = empty. Read by sub_obj_tick_all

name: ram_obj_x
comment: 16 objects x 2: X position, whole part; fraction at $097E. Set by anim opcodes $28/$3B

name: ram_obj_y
comment: 16 objects x 2: Y position, whole part; fraction at $099E

name: ram_obj_z
comment: 16 objects x 2: Z position, whole part; fraction at $09BE

name: ram_obj_x_frac
comment: 16 objects x 2: X fraction; anim opcodes $28/$3B set it to $8000

name: ram_obj_y_frac
comment: 16 objects x 2: Y fraction

name: ram_obj_z_frac
comment: 16 objects x 2: Z fraction

name: ram_obj_vx
comment: 16 objects x 2: X velocity, whole part; fraction at $0A3E. 8.8 fixed point, set by wait-action 4 ($CN) and anim opcode $2E

name: ram_obj_vy
comment: 16 objects x 2: Y velocity, whole part; fraction at $0A5E

name: ram_obj_vz
comment: 16 objects x 2: Z velocity, whole part; fraction at $0A7E

name: ram_obj_vx_frac
comment: 16 objects x 2: X velocity fraction

name: ram_obj_vy_frac
comment: 16 objects x 2: Y velocity fraction

name: ram_obj_vz_frac
comment: 16 objects x 2: Z velocity fraction. Anim opcode $39 zeroes all six velocity words

name: ram_obj_field0
comment: 16 objects x 2: generic object word 0; selected by anim `field` operands through tbl_anim_obj_fields

name: ram_obj_field1
comment: 16 objects x 2: generic object word 1

name: ram_obj_field2
comment: 16 objects x 2: generic object word 2

name: ram_obj_field3
comment: 16 objects x 2: generic object word 3

name: ram_obj_queue
comment: 16 objects x 2: OAM priority queue; anim opcode $3C writes it, sub_obj_draw copies it to $7E:2880 for sub_oam_enqueue

name: ram_obj_hook_addr
comment: 16 objects x 2: per-object long hook address, called by $80:9510 each tick. Anim opcode $08 sets it; $80:9D9B resets it to $80:94C6

name: ram_obj_hook_bank
comment: 16 objects x 2: bank of ram_obj_hook_addr; negative skips the call

name: ram_obj_frame_index
comment: 16 objects x 2: index into the object's frame pointer table; negative = invisible

name: ram_obj_frame_table_addr
comment: 16 objects x 2: address of the object's frame POINTER TABLE; set only by sub_obj_set_frame_ptr

name: ram_obj_frame_table_bank
comment: 16 objects x 2: bank of the frame pointer table

name: ram_obj_vec_update
comment: 16 objects x 2: per-object update vector, JSR ($0BDE,X); default $9E5C

name: ram_obj_vec_draw
comment: 16 objects x 2: per-object draw vector, JSR ($0BFE,X); default $9E8E = sub_obj_draw

name: ram_obj_vec_physics
comment: 16 objects x 2: per-object physics vector, JSR ($0C1E,X); default $9E33

name: ram_anim_thread_link
comment: 31 threads x 2: thread spawned by anim opcode $07; anim opcode $13 ends it

name: ram_anim_stack_ptr
comment: 31 threads x 2: local stack pointer into ram_anim_locals; zeroed on spawn

name: ram_anim_wait
comment: 31 threads x 2: script wait timer in game ticks; $FFFF = halted. Decremented by sub_anim_script_run

name: ram_anim_pc
comment: 31 threads x 2: animation script program counter, used as Y against [$D0]

name: ram_anim_bank
comment: 31 threads x 2: animation script bank, copied to $D2

name: ram_anim_reg
comment: 31 threads x 2: the animation thread register. Subject of anim opcodes $0A/$0B/$10/$11/$16/$17/$1D-$21/$27, and the A passed to a wait-action 7 far call

name: ram_anim_locals
comment: 31 threads x 8 local bytes; pointer computed into $D4 as $0DBE + 8*thread

name: ram_sfx_port1_toggle
comment: bit 7 XORed into every port-1 write by sub_spc_sfx_trigger so a repeated id still changes the port; SPC $1143 shifts it away

name: ram_spc_current_song
comment: id of the song last uploaded ($7E+n), 0 after a stop; sub_spc_play_song skips the upload when the request matches ($80:B4CD)

name: ram_sfx_last_id
comment: last SFX id sub_spc_sfx_trigger sent to $2141

name: ram_sfx_slot_value
comment: 3 channel slots x 2 bytes; each holds the tbl_sfx_id value of the effect occupying it. Compared at $80:B5AC, also polled from bank $82

name: ram_sfx_slot_priority
comment: 3 slots x 2 bytes written from tbl_sfx_priority at $80:B5C4; no reader found anywhere in banks $80-$87

name: ram_sfx_disable
comment: nonzero makes sub_spc_sfx_trigger refuse every request ($80:B554); cleared at $80:B687

name: ram_thread_helpers
comment: twelve helper routines copied here from dat_thread_helpers at boot so any bank can JSR them; they take inline operands. $1018 clone, $1030 frame+yield, $105E position, $1084/$10A3/$10C2/$10E7/$1104/$1151/$116A/$119D/$11D6 motion. See tools/objanim.py

name: ram_player_x2
comment: player whose turn it is, x 2 (0 or 2): the index into the interleaved per-player ball block $D87A-$D96E and $D7D4/$D7D6 (emulated, 2P game)

name: ram_current_player
comment: player whose turn it is, 0 or 1; stored as an enemy's owner when the ball takes it ($82:8A98)

name: ram_thr_type
comment: thread objects, 64 slots x 2: object type, $FFFF = free. Slot index is in dp $D2 (D = $1E00 in thread context)

name: ram_thr_list
comment: thread objects: scheduling list, the high byte of the type table's second word

name: ram_thr_resume_pc
comment: thread objects: address the thread resumes at; written by sub_thread_yield and by the $1030 helper

name: ram_thr_resume_bank
comment: thread objects: bank of ram_thr_resume_pc

name: ram_thr_handler
comment: thread objects: per-frame handler address, bank in $511C. 203 immediate stores

name: ram_thr_draw
comment: thread objects: draw routine address, bank in $521C. Defaults $80:E55A (world) and $80:E5A2 (screen)

name: ram_thr_wait
comment: thread objects: frames left to wait

name: ram_thr_owner
comment: thread objects: for an enemy, who took it: 2 = nobody yet, else the player ($1809) whose ball hit it, stored at $82:8A98. sub_count_enemies_left counts the 2s (emulated, hole 1)

name: ram_thr_height_class
comment: thread objects: for an enemy, its hover height in height steps (converted through tbl_height_z_lo/_hi); 0 = on the ground

name: ram_obj2_frame_index
comment: thread objects: index into the table at ram_obj2_frame_ptr; negative = not drawn. 745 stores, 309 INC

name: ram_obj2_frame_ptr
comment: thread objects: frame pointer TABLE (word address in bank $89), indexed by ram_obj2_frame_index. $80:E585 does LDA $5D9C,X / ASL / ADC $5E1C,X / STA $DE / LDA [$DE] / STA $C0. Objects with their own draw routine ($87:8C93, $87:932E, $87:98AA) keep a frame LIST here instead. 321 store sites

name: ram_obj2_queue
comment: thread objects: OAM priority queue, loaded into A before JML $80:8B09 by $80:E59A

name: ram_obj2_x
comment: thread objects: X. Set by the JSR $105E helper; the draw routines subtract the camera at $86

name: ram_obj2_y
comment: thread objects: Y. Set by the JSR $105E helper; the draw routines subtract the camera at $88

name: ram_thr_return_pc
comment: thread objects: continuation a shared script segment returns through with JML [$1EDE]; bank in $649C. 82 immediate stores

name: ram_kanim_object
comment: Kirby animation threads, 8 x 2: the script object animated. See docs/animation.md "Kirby's animation scripts"

name: ram_kanim_statevar
comment: Kirby animation threads: address of the WRAM state variable

name: ram_kanim_table
comment: Kirby animation threads: address of the state -> script table

name: ram_kanim_pc
comment: Kirby animation threads: script PC (bank $87)

name: ram_kanim_wait
comment: Kirby animation threads: frames left to wait

name: ram_snap_keep
comment: object 61's keep-alive, shared by every live 61: $FFFF at each of its bursts ($85:CF30), cleared by every snap push ($82:A5F7); a 61 that finds it set after its 8 ticks exits

name: ram_enemy_list
comment: the hole's enemies: actor-record offsets (index x 2), ended by a negative word; with ram_actor_slot and ram_thr_owner gives the enemies left

name: ram_cup_slot
comment: thread slot of the last enemy, the one that becomes the cup ($82:8AEE); $FFFF until then, reset per hole at $80:C188

name: ram_cup_actor
comment: actor-record offset of the cup (the last enemy); its cell is ram_actor_cell_x/_y at this offset. $FFFF until then

name: ram_stars
comment: enemies taken by player 1, player 2 ($82:8AA0); moved between them when a 2P hit steals one ($82:8B0F)

name: ram_boost_hum
comment: a straight boost hit's launch speed ($82:9E6B), cleared by every other exit of the boost handlers; object 112's hum ($84:87D4) runs while it is set and clears it; docs/tiles.md

name: ram_course_number
comment: course number; hole index = course*8 + hole

name: ram_course_slot
comment: 2 * course, set on the course map (every snapshot of the map-picked runs game/game2/game4/extra, courses 0-15; two_player 16); a poke of $6A5A alone leaves it 0; indexes the water ripple base $84:84AF and the hole song list $80:C99D; notes/port-v2-phase1-courses.md

name: ram_hole_in_course
comment: hole 0-7 within the course

name: ram_enemy_hit_latch
comment: per player: set on an enemy hit by $82:8967, cleared by $82:8A21 when the ball is in the enemy cell outside its middle half, so one pass counts once; shared with the pillar ($82:9566), the arrows (sub_arrow_turn) and the snap panels (sub_snap_push, cleared by sub_snap_gate)

name: ram_ball_mode_index
comment: ball mode * 8 + class * 2 (class from tbl_friction_class): index into tbl_ball_gravity and tbl_roll_friction ($81:80E6)

name: ram_shot_power
comment: shot power P, from the power meter by sub_shot_power; launch speed in sub_launch_velocity (emulated: $1104 grounder, $1156 fly shot at the same meter value)

name: ram_power_meter
comment: power meter position during the shot panel, counts up to $6B3C and back; A latches it ($81:BFFE)

name: ram_spin_side
comment: side-spin selector 0-12 (6 = none) during the spin stage: Left/Right move it every 8 frames ($81:C12E); copied to $D9B8 (emulated)

name: ram_spin_topback
comment: top/back selector 0-12 (6 = none): moves by itself 6->0->12->0 in a fly shot only, latched by A ($81:C170) (emulated)

name: ram_course_shape
comment: course grid layer 1: terrain shape id $00-$1B per cell; $00 = gap

name: ram_course_height
comment: course grid layer 3: elevation $00-$0F per cell

name: ram_course_flags
comment: course grid layer 4: low nibble = wall flag per cell edge, N/E/S/W

name: ram_course_content
comment: course grid layer 2: object id per cell, looked up in $82:BDBC at load

name: ram_course_header
comment: the 28-byte hole header; +2 = grid width, +4 = grid height

name: ram_course_row_offset
comment: course table 7: word offset of each map row inside the two tilemaps; read at $80:BE36

name: ram_course_row_left
comment: course table 5: first column of each map row; $FFFF = empty row. Read at $80:BE17

name: ram_course_row_right
comment: course table 6: last column of each map row; equal to the left value means the row is not drawn

name: ram_hole_index3
comment: hole index * 3; the index into every bank $88 course table

name: ram_tile_counts
comment: per layer-2 value, the count of cells that hold it (hole 7: $60-$6F match its grid exactly, snapshot build/emu/prog/f012000); read by $82:BD11

name: ram_actor_kind
comment: actor records (32 x 2, written by sub_spawn_actor): the tile id that spawned it; set to 8 (the cup tile) when the record becomes the cup ($82:8B7A)

name: ram_actor_slot
comment: actor records: thread slot of the spawned object, $FFFF for a cell recorded without one

name: ram_actor_cell_x
comment: actor records: spawn cell column

name: ram_actor_cell_y
comment: actor records: spawn cell row

name: ram_surface_kind
comment: set by sub_hole_surface_gfx: 0 none, 1 boost panels (object 112), 2 water (object 113); gfx set A entry 1 reloads the water tiles when 2

name: ram_hit_code
comment: hit reaction code for Kirby animation state 40 (burn / electrocuted) and the other hit states, from the other ball's ability

name: ram_courses_cleared
comment: 0-8, set on the course map by $81:FBCD from SRAM. 8 in 1-player mode sends the main flow to the final stage ($80:F20E -> sub_final_stage)

name: ram_kirby_facing8
comment: Kirby's facing, 8 directions; switched on by the standing and aiming scripts

name: ram_kirby_shot_angle
comment: the shot's angle, 16 directions; state 6 (curl into the ball) switches on it

name: ram_kirby_anim_state
comment: player 1 animation state, 0-50: the Kirby animation thread runs $87:9ADE[state] on every change

name: ram_kirby2_anim_state
comment: player 2 animation state, table $87:B990

name: ram_kirby_health
comment: Kirby's health (the tomatoes): 4 at the start of a hole, -1 per shot ($83:AC12), +1 per enemy taken ($83:AC01); after a shot 1-2 -> animation state 11 (tired), 0 -> state 10 (asleep). Emulated

name: ram_lives
comment: lives; at 0 after a hole the main flow takes the game-over path ($80:F387): GAME OVER and CONTINUE / GAME END, scene 9

name: ram_copy_ability
comment: player 1's copy ability, 0 none, 1-10; Kirby animation state 8 switches on it

name: ram_p_spin
comment: per player, interleaved by $1803: spin x $D866, spin y $D86A, pending $D86E, saved at $81:C2C4

name: ram_kirby_anim_index
comment: Kirby's frame index as the animation scripts set it (player 2 $D960); copied to the script object's $0B7E by $82:F0F8 while the ball is in play

name: ram_shot_aim
comment: aim direction, degrees 0-359 (0 = +x, 90 = +y)

name: ram_shot_elevation
comment: launch elevation, degrees: 0 grounder ($81:B6BC), 60 fly shot ($81:B656), 65 Hi-Jump ($82:CC4F); non-zero also selects the fly-shot spin rules (emulated)

name: ram_guide_spin_side
comment: side-spin selector seen by the shot guide; reset to 6 when the shot kind changes

name: ram_shot_over
comment: 1 once the ball has rolled slower than $DA46 for 30 frames ($81:A612); counter $D9C0 (emulated)

name: ram_ball_mode
comment: 0 normal, 1-10 the copy abilities in DEMOPLAY order (emulated), up to 21; row of tbl_ball_gravity/tbl_roll_friction; $0A skips most physics

name: ram_spin
comment: fly shot: spin impulse x ($D9CC), y ($D9CE) added at the first bounce; grounder: $D9CC = curve rate (rad/65536 per frame). By sub_shot_spin (emulated)

name: ram_spin_pending
comment: non-zero while spin is still to apply; cleared at every landing ($81:895F) and step hit

name: ram_ball_vel
comment: ball velocity x, y, vertical (player block $D87A, $D87E, $D882)

name: ram_ball_heading
comment: direction of motion in degrees (sub_ball_heading); $D9DE 16-way, $D9E0 32-way, $D9E2 last heading while moving

name: ram_edge_step_dir
comment: edge (N/E/S/W = 0-3, N = -y) by which the ball entered a cell with a step, else $FFFF (sub_edge_crossing)

name: ram_edge_wall_dir
comment: edge of a layer-4 wall flag crossed this frame, else $FFFF

name: ram_ball_airborne
comment: 1 airborne, 0 rolling (player block $D8A6)

name: ram_ball_x
comment: ball x: fraction $D9F0, cell $D9F2 (work copy; player block $D8AA/$D8AE). See docs/physics.md

name: ram_ball_y
comment: ball y: fraction $D9F4, cell $D9F6 (player block $D8B2/$D8B6)

name: ram_ball_z
comment: ball height 16.16, one height step = $5A82 (player block $D8BA/$D8BE)

name: ram_probe_shape
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: terrain shape under the active object

name: ram_probe_height
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: elevation of that cell

name: ram_probe_surface
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: surface code 0-8 under the ball (flat, 4 ramps, 4 diagonals)

name: ram_probe_ground_z
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: 32-bit surface Z at the exact position

name: ram_probe_tile
comment: sub_terrain_probe output: layer-2 special-tile byte under the object

name: ram_ball_prev
comment: previous frame's $D9EC-$DA0B, saved by $81:8751, restored in part by $81:87B2

name: ram_damp_defaults
comment: sources of $DA3C, $DA3E, $DA40, $DA42 ($7D6F, $5332, $5332, $6665 emulated)

name: ram_gravity
comment: added to vz every airborne frame ($81:899F); $FFC0 from tbl_ball_gravity[0]

name: ram_roll_friction
comment: rolling friction from tbl_roll_friction each rolling frame; decel = $DA3A/256 per frame along the heading

name: ram_bounce_damp_xy
comment: Q15 factor for vx and vy at a bounce ($81:8975); reloaded from $DA30 ($7D6F, 0.98) every airborne frame, so a friction tile override lasts one landing (emulated value)

name: ram_bounce_damp_z
comment: Q15 factor for vz at a bounce; reloaded from $DA32 ($5332, 0.65) every airborne frame (emulated value)

name: ram_step_damp
comment: Q15 factor for the velocity component normal to a step the ball runs into ($81:941E), $5332

name: ram_step_damp_z
comment: Q15 factor for vz when the ball hits a step in the air ($81:88DD), $6665

name: ram_rest_speed
comment: |vx|+|vy| below this for 30 frames ends the shot ($81:A5F8); 1

name: ram_air_frames
comment: frames since the last bounce; under $10 at a landing the ball settles (emulated)

name: ram_ball_holed
comment: 1 = holed (set by $82:AE2E), 2 after the hole-out; player copy $D956

name: ram_edge_step
comment: step height at a cell edge crossed this frame, half steps: > 0 a step up (bounce), < 0 a drop (launch)

name: ram_ball_events
comment: this frame: $DA4E bounced, $DA50 hit a step, $DA52 hit a wall

name: ram_button_mod
comment: A/Y pressed while moving: kind $DA76 (0 A, 2 Y, $FFFF none), window $DA78 (22), timer $DA7A (15 air / 3 ground) (emulated)

name: ram_medal_flags
comment: six words set by sub_medal_flags: every normal course has a medal value >= 1, >= 2, >= 3 ($EAA9/$EAAB/$EAAD), then the same for the extra courses ($EAAF/$EAB1/$EAB3). Gate the title menu's MAP SELECT ($EAAD), SOUND ROOM ($EAAF), DANCE SELECT ($EAB1) and the 1P/2P extra-course items

name: ram_extra_game
comment: 0 normal courses, 1 the extra game: set from the 1PLAY GAME and MAP SELECT menus ($83:B7EF, $83:B967); halves King Dedede's damage ($87:878E)

name: ram_dedede_hp
comment: King Dedede's hit points: 24 at the start ($87:E6B4); each hit subtracts ram_dedede_damage (halved in the extra game, $87:878E); 0 ends the fight (emulated: 4 hits of 6)

name: ram_dedede_pos
comment: King Dedede: x fraction:cell ($ED2F/$ED31), y ($ED33/$ED35), height 16.16 ($ED37/$ED39)

name: ram_dedede_damage
comment: damage of the last hit, from the ball's height above the ground through tbl_dedede_damage ($87:EF62)

name: ram_course_bg1
comment: course table 8, row-packed BG1 tilemap; uploaded a column at a time to VRAM $5000

name: ram_course_bg2
comment: course table 9, row-packed BG2 tilemap; uploaded to VRAM $5800

name: sub_init
comment: console init; entered via the RESET thunk. STZ $4200 / REP #$30 / MVN $00,$00 / TXS

name: sub_dma_cgram
comment: DMA the $7E:0400 CGRAM staging buffer to $2122; mode $22, count from tbl_cgram_dma

name: loc_nmi_cgram_dma
comment: NMI: DMA ram_cgram_staging to CGRAM (emulated)

name: tbl_cgram_dma
comment: 3 sets of (size, source, CGADD) for sub_dma_cgram, indexed by $00A0 * 8

name: loc_nmi_oam_dma
comment: NMI: DMA the OAM buffer at $7E:0600 to OAM (emulated)

name: sub_read_joypad
comment: auto-joypad read into ram_joy_held / _pressed / _repeat (emulated)

name: sub_obsel_set
comment: write $2101 OBSEL. A = sprite size selector (ASL x5), X = VRAM byte address of the sprite tile page (X>>13 = name base). JSL/RTL

name: sub_bg1_set
comment: BG1 tilemap and character base: Y = tilemap word address, X low 2 bits = map size, X >> 12 = char base in 4K words

name: sub_bg2_set
comment: as sub_bg1_set for BG2

name: sub_bg3_set
comment: as sub_bg1_set for BG3

name: sub_bg4_set
comment: as sub_bg1_set for BG4

name: sub_vram_queue
comment: queue 8-byte VRAM transfer records (terminated by $FFFF) into the ring at $7E:0200

name: sub_vram_enqueue_one
comment: copy one 8-byte record into the $7E:0200 ring, or DMA it directly when $7D is negative

name: loc_vram_queue_dma
comment: the DMA trigger that drains the $7E:0200 VRAM transfer ring (emulated)

name: tbl_edge_bitmask
comment: 01 02 04 08 10 20 40 80; entries 0-3 mask the layer-4 wall bits for N/E/S/W

name: sub_oam_reset_ptrs
comment: set OAM buffer pointers ($2C=$0600 low, $2E/$32=$0800 high) and zero the 10 queue counts

name: sub_oam_enqueue
comment: dispatch on $7E:2880 to one of 10 OAM priority queues; A=frame list ptr, X=screen X, Y=screen Y

name: sub_oam_build
comment: drain all 10 priority queues into the OAM staging buffer at $7E:0600

name: loc_oam_build_set_dbr
comment: PEA $7E89 / PLB: frame lists are always read with DBR=$89, whatever bank the frame TABLE is in

name: sub_oam_emit_frame
comment: walk a 5-byte metasprite part list, emit hardware sprites. See docs/graphics.md

name: loc_oam_frame_priority
comment: control record $7E: read the byte at $7E:<ptr>, bits 0-1 -> bits 12-13 of $3F, then continue the SAME list at +3 via sub_oam_emit_frame_alt. A priority override, not a continuation

name: loc_oam_frame_follow_ptr
comment: control record $80: LDA $0001,Y / TAY, an absolute jump to another list in the same bank

name: sub_oam_emit_frame_alt
comment: sub_oam_emit_frame with the $3F priority override applied ($80:8E67 ORA $3F); entered from loc_oam_frame_priority. Same record format

name: sub_apply_screen_params_entry
comment: prologue that falls into sub_apply_screen_params; A = bank, Y = block address

name: sub_apply_screen_params
comment: apply a screen setup block: byte 0 -> $2105 BGMODE, byte 1 -> $2101 OBSEL, then word pairs to sub_obsel_set. A=bank Y=block. No direct callers; dispatched

name: sub_cgram_partial
comment: A = byte count, X = source address, Y = first CGRAM colour index. The MVN at $80:90D4 hardwires the source bank to $98

name: sub_cgram_list
comment: runs a list of (bytes, source, CGRAM index) words until $FF through sub_cgram_partial; the list's bank is the caller's; notes/port-v2-phase1-courses.md

name: sub_obj_spawn
comment: JSL; allocate an object and start its script. A = object type (index into tbl_obj_type_scripts), X = world X, Y = world Y. Returns $FFFF if no slot

name: sub_obj_tick_all
comment: JSL; walk the ram_obj_list_head chain, running each object's physics, update and draw vectors. Sets $D0 = $0000 for the script long pointer

name: sub_anim_script_run
comment: the animation script interpreter; one thread per call. See docs/animation.md

name: tbl_anim_opcodes
comment: 61 word targets for JSR ($95B6,X); animation script opcodes $00-$3C

name: tbl_anim_wait_actions
comment: 8 word targets for JSR ($9630,X); packed opcodes $70-$FF, action = bits 4-6, wait ticks = bits 0-3

name: sub_anim_obj_destroy
comment: anim opcode $00: JSR sub_obj_destroy, then wait = $FFFF. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_loop_begin
comment: anim opcode $01: push PC + a 1-byte count as a 3-byte local-stack frame. Opcode $24 enters at $9655 with the count from ram_anim_reg. 1 operand byte

name: sub_anim_loop_end
comment: anim opcode $02: decrement the pushed count, branch back to the pushed PC or pop the frame. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_jmp
comment: anim opcode $19: near jump, same bank. 2 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_jml
comment: anim opcode $03: far jump, sets Y and the script bank $D2. 3 operand bytes (addr16, bank8)

name: sub_anim_jsr
comment: anim opcode $1A: near call, pushes a 2-byte frame. 2 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_rts
comment: anim opcode $1B: near return; an empty local stack falls into sub_anim_end_thread. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_jsl
comment: anim opcode $04: far call, pushes PC + bank as a 3-byte frame. 3 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_rtl
comment: anim opcode $05: far return; an empty local stack falls into sub_anim_end_thread. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_wait
comment: anim opcode $06: set ram_anim_wait directly, 0-255 ticks. 1 operand byte

name: sub_anim_set_frame
comment: wait-action 0 (opcodes $8N): ram_obj_frame_index = next byte; $FF stores $FFFF (hidden)

name: sub_anim_set_pos
comment: anim opcode $3B: set X, Y and Z at once, each fraction $8000. 6 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_set_vel_x
comment: wait-action 4 (opcodes $CN): set X velocity, whole and fractional words

name: sub_anim_set_vel_y
comment: wait-action 5 (opcodes $DN): set Y velocity

name: sub_anim_set_vel_z
comment: wait-action 6 (opcodes $EN): set Z velocity

name: sub_anim_stop
comment: anim opcode $39: zero all three velocity pairs, whole and fractional. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_set_queue
comment: anim opcode $3C: ram_obj_queue = byte. 1 operand byte

name: sub_anim_far_call
comment: wait-action 7 (opcodes $7N and $FN): far call addr16,bank8 via JML [$0876]

name: sub_anim_switch
comment: anim opcode $10: jump via ram_anim_reg into a table of `count` words; register >= count skips past the table. 1 + 2*count operand bytes

name: sub_anim_switch_call
comment: anim opcode $11: sub_anim_switch that first pushes the address after the table as a 2-byte frame, matched by sub_anim_rts

name: sub_anim_end_thread
comment: anim opcode $0C: unlink the thread via $80:9D18; also destroys the object when $7E:08BE,X is negative. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_spawn
comment: anim opcode $07: allocate a thread via $80:9D09 starting at addr in the same bank, linked through ram_anim_thread_link. 2 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_end_linked_thread
comment: anim opcode $13: sub_anim_end_thread applied to ram_anim_thread_link. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_set_obj_hook
comment: anim opcode $08: store addr16 + bank8 into ram_obj_hook_addr/bank. 3 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_halt
comment: anim opcode $09: DEY back onto the opcode byte, wait = $FFFF. The script terminator; all four tbl_obj_type_scripts scripts end on it. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_anim_frame_next
comment: wait-action 1 (opcodes $9N): INC ram_obj_frame_index

name: sub_anim_frame_prev
comment: wait-action 2 (opcodes $AN): DEC ram_obj_frame_index

name: sub_anim_frame_add
comment: wait-action 3 (opcodes $BN): ram_obj_frame_index += signed byte

name: tbl_anim_rmw_ops
comment: 4 word targets for the read-modify-write anim opcodes $0D/$14/$18/$27: 0 AND, 1 ORA, 2 ADC, 3 EOR. Handlers follow at $9B18/$9B1F/$9B26/$9B2E

name: tbl_anim_obj_fields
comment: 4 word bases for the anim `field` operand: $0A9E, $0ABE, $0ADE, $0AFE. The handler adds $D8 (object index * 2)

name: sub_anim_reset_obj_hook
comment: anim opcode $0F: JSR $80:9D9B, ram_obj_hook back to $80:94C6. 0 operand bytes

name: sub_obj_set_frame_ptr
comment: anim opcode $1C: store a frame POINTER TABLE addr into $7E:0B9E,X and bank into $7E:0BBE,X. The only STA $0B9E,X in the ROM

name: sub_obj_destroy
comment: JSR; free object X: mark $7E:087E,X = $FFFF, reset the hook ($9D9B) and run three teardown routines ($9CD7, $9CB1, $9CCD)

name: sub_anim_thread_alloc
comment: JSR; take the head of the free thread list $7E:0870. Carry set = none free

name: sub_anim_thread_unlink
comment: JSR; JSR $80:9D25, then push thread Y back onto the $7E:0870 list

name: sub_anim_far_thunk
comment: JML [$0876]: the indirect long jump wait-action 7 and $80:9510 call through. JSL/RTL

name: sub_obj_reset_hook
comment: JSR; ram_obj_hook_addr/bank = $80:94C6, the default per-object long hook

name: sub_obj_draw
comment: look up the current frame from the object's list and enqueue it if on screen

name: loc_obj_vec_null
comment: a bare RTS. Object types 0 and 1 point their draw and physics vectors here, turning both off

name: tbl_obj_type_scripts
comment: 4 entries x (addr16, bank8): object type -> animation script. Bounded above by sub_hal_decompress

name: sub_hal_decompress
comment: HAL LZ decompressor. A=src bank, X=src addr, Y=dest addr, DBR=dest bank. JSL/RTL

name: sub_decompress_queue
comment: queue an asset for the resumable decompressor; writes the $7E:531C..$579C arrays

name: sub_hal_decompress_resume
comment: resumable variant of sub_hal_decompress; state in DP $AB/$AD/$AF, $B1 bytes per call

name: sub_mul_16x8
comment: JSL; A * (signed low byte of X) through $211B/$211C -> $389E (24-bit); $389F = A*X/256

name: sub_cos_deg
comment: JSL; A = cos(A degrees), Q15, from $80:A656

name: sub_sin_deg
comment: JSL; A = sin(A degrees), Q15, from tbl_sin_deg

name: sub_atan2_deg
comment: JSL; A = heading in degrees 0-359 of the vector (A, X) (emulated: 180 for (-v, 0))

name: tbl_sin_deg
comment: sin of 0-449 degrees, Q15 words ($7FFF at 90); $80:A656 (+90) is the cosine table

name: sub_spc_ipl_upload
comment: SPC700 IPL boot handshake; uploads the driver from tbl_spc_ipl_blocks

name: tbl_spc_ipl_blocks
comment: one block: len $0A0B -> SPC $0800, then a $0000 terminator whose addr is the entry point

name: dat_spc_driver
comment: N-SPC driver image, loaded to SPC $0800. Contains the string *Ver S1.20* at +$092D

name: loc_nspc_main_loop
comment: SPC $0866; waits for timer 0 ($FD), adds $20*ticks to $43 (carry polls port 1) and tempo*ticks to $51 (carry runs sub_nspc_tick)

name: loc_nspc_tempo_gate
comment: SPC $0884; $51 += LOW BYTE of $53 * timer ticks. A pass of 7+ ticks at tempo $25 overflows and a whole sequencer tick is lost

name: sub_nspc_port_mirror
comment: SPC $08B2; copies APU ports $F4+X to $00+X. The 6 bytes at SPC $08B6 are what spc_extract.make_spc patches

name: sub_nspc_note
comment: SPC $08BF; note/tie/rest/percussion. $CA-$DF sets the instrument via sub_nspc_set_instrument and forces pitch index $24; $C8/$C9 return without a key-on

name: sub_nspc_next_word
comment: SPC $09B9; reads the next 16-bit word of a sequence word list and advances $40. Returns flags set from the HIGH byte

name: sub_nspc_start_port0
comment: SPC $09CC; starts the sequence id in A (from APU port 0): $04 = id, $40 = table[$3AFE + 2*id], $0C = 2

name: loc_nspc_reset_tempo
comment: SPC $0A19; end of the voice reset on every song start: master volume $59 = $C0, tempo $53 = $20

name: sub_nspc_tick
comment: SPC $0A22; the sequencer tick. Reads port 0, walks the word list, loads patterns, runs one event per voice

name: loc_nspc_repeat_word
comment: SPC $0A4B; word-list repeat, count in $42. $01-$7F jumps that many times; $81+ is reloaded every visit and loops forever (all looping songs use $C8)

name: loc_nspc_voice_loop
comment: SPC $0AA6; per-voice event loop of the tick. MOV $5E,X at SPC $0AA8 runs once per tick, twice on a pattern change

name: sub_nspc_write_volume
comment: SPC $0B9F; writes a voice volume to the DSP, scaled by APU port 2 ($02) unless the voice's bit is set in $22 (owned by an effect)

name: sub_nspc_command
comment: SPC $0BAF; dispatches commands $E0-$FA through tbl_nspc_cmd_jump, pre-fetching one argument byte when tbl_nspc_cmd_args is nonzero

name: sub_nspc_fetch
comment: SPC $0BC1; fetch one track byte through the per-voice pointer $30+X and advance it

name: sub_nspc_set_instrument
comment: SPC $0BCB; index*6 + $0600, bytes 0-3 to DSP $x4-$x7 and 4-5 to the pitch scaler. An index >= $80 resolves as $5F + index - $CA (percussion)

name: tbl_nspc_cmd_jump_base
comment: SPC $0D5E; the dispatcher indexes this with (2*cmd) & $FF, so the live part is tbl_nspc_cmd_jump at +$C0

name: tbl_nspc_cmd_args_base
comment: SPC $0DF4; indexed with cmd - $80, so the live part is tbl_nspc_cmd_args at +$60

name: tbl_nspc_cmd_jump
comment: SPC $0E1E; 27 command handler addresses, $E0 through $FA. Bytes $FB-$FF have no entry and are invalid in a track

name: tbl_nspc_cmd_args
comment: SPC $0E54; argument count for commands $E0-$FA: 1 1 2 3 0 1 2 1 2 1 1 3 0 1 2 3 1 3 3 0 1 3 0 3 3 3 1. Also added by the look-ahead at SPC $0F69 to skip a command

name: sub_nspc_lookahead
comment: SPC $0F34; when a note's gate expires this scans forward through the track (following $EF calls) to decide whether to key off. A $C8 tie suppresses it

name: loc_nspc_voice_volume
comment: SPC $10B7; master volume $59 x velocity x track volume, squared, into $0321+X. Applies to effect voices too

name: tbl_nspc_echo_fir
comment: SPC $10DE; echo FIR coefficient presets, 8 bytes each, selected by the third argument of command $F7

name: tbl_nspc_pitch
comment: SPC $1112; 13 words, one equal-tempered octave of DSP pitch values for octave 5. Entry 12 is exactly twice entry 0; lower octaves are right shifts

name: sub_nspc_port1
comment: SPC $1137; APU port 1 poll. Acts only when the value changes; id 0 stops every voice flagged in $22, otherwise ASL A discards the toggle bit and starts the sequence

name: sub_nspc_start_seq
comment: SPC $1168; the one sequence-start routine, used by songs and SFX alike. Pointer = $3AFE + 2*id, its first word is a pattern, that pattern's 8 words become the voice track pointers

name: sub_spc_play_song
comment: write a song id to APU port 0; ids below $7E are ignored, $7E+ uploads first

name: sub_spc_command
comment: write a command byte to APU port 0 without the upload path

name: sub_spc_preload_song
comment: upload a song without starting it; paired with $80:B4F1 at $83:D90F/$83:D921 (song 32) and $83:D9FF/$83:DA11 (song 16)

name: sub_spc_sfx_trigger
comment: allocate an SFX channel from tbl_sfx_slots / tbl_sfx_priority and signal port 1

name: sub_sfx_slot_check
comment: compares tbl_sfx_id[X] against the value in slot Y at $1008; carry clear means the running effect wins and the request is refused

name: sub_sfx_claim_slot
comment: writes tbl_sfx_id[X] to $1008+Y and tbl_sfx_priority[X] to $100E+Y

name: sub_spc_reset_state
comment: clear the driver's SNES-side mirror at $1004-$1012

name: sub_spc_set_volume
comment: store a master volume to $1003 and APU port 2

name: sub_spc_upload_set
comment: upload an init set (samples / directory / instruments) via tbl_spc_init_sets

name: sub_spc_upload_song
comment: upload one song's block chain from tbl_spc_songs to SPC $6502

name: sub_spc_send_block
comment: byte-stream one block chain to the APU through ports 0 and 2

name: tbl_spc_init_sets
comment: 2 entries; each points to a zero-terminated list of long pointers to block chains

name: tbl_spc_songs
comment: 33 songs x (addr16, bank16); song id = $7E + index

name: tbl_sfx_slots
comment: per-SFX channel-allocation mask used by sub_spc_sfx_trigger

name: tbl_sfx_id
comment: per-SFX id byte compared against the active-channel state at $1008

name: tbl_sfx_priority
comment: per-SFX priority stored to $100E when a channel is claimed

name: loc_course_row_copy
comment: copy one column of the course tilemaps into the row buffers: index = t7[r] + (col - t5[r]); the definition of the row-packed layout

name: loc_course_col_upload_bg1
comment: queue the BG1 row buffer to VRAM $5000 + column

name: loc_course_col_upload_bg2
comment: as above for BG2, VRAM $5800

name: sub_course_enter
comment: course entry: load graphics sets and tilesets, then JSL sub_course_load_bg

name: sub_shot_end_state
comment: after a shot (X = $1803): Kirby's animation state 11 (tired, health 1-2, $80:C7AE) or 10 (asleep, health 0, $80:C7E6). State 9 (wait for the next turn) is set by the routine just before it, at $80:C756

name: sub_play_hole_song
comment: the hole's song: 27 if $ED5B, stop if $00C2 or $ED07, else $80:C99D[$6A5C] -> [$6A5E]; JML $80:B4AC; docs/audio.md

name: tbl_hole_songs
comment: 28 word pointers to 8-byte lists of song requests ($7E + n), by $6A5C = 2 * course; docs/audio.md

name: sub_load_asset
comment: decompress a stream to $7F:0000 (bank pushed as $7E7F); A=bank X=addr Y=dest

name: sub_load_asset_vram
comment: as sub_load_asset to $7F:0000, then pass the Y parameter block to sub_vram_queue

name: sub_scene_screen_setup
comment: A = scene number; index tbl_scene_screen_blocks and apply the block via $80:903A

name: tbl_scene_screen_blocks
comment: 20 word pointers to screen setup blocks (BGMODE, OBSEL, per-BG map/char bases)

name: dat_screen_block_course
comment: course scene: BGMODE $09, OBSEL $03 (OBJ name base $6000), BG1 map $5000, BG2 map $5800, BG3 map $3C00 char $4000

name: sub_load_gfx_set_a
comment: jump table of 8 graphics loaders; entry 0 runs on course entry

name: sub_load_gfx_course_tiles
comment: gfx set A entry 0: stage $8B:DAB1 at $7F:2000 and $90:9E9E at $7F:0000, then upload 27136 bytes to VRAM $0000

name: dat_vram_records_course_tiles
comment: one record: slot 0, $6A00 bytes, src $7F:0000, VRAM word $0000 - the 848-tile course page

name: sub_load_gfx_water_tiles
comment: gfx set A entry 2: queue $80:CCEF (gfx_water_tiles -> VRAM $1800, tiles $180-$1AB), or the zero fill $80:CCF8 while $7E:69CA is set

name: sub_load_gfx_set_b
comment: jump table of 6 graphics loaders

name: sub_load_tileset
comment: jump table of 28 tileset loaders; entry 0 loads the course tiles to VRAM $6000

name: sub_load_palette_set
comment: jump table of 33 palette loaders; entry 0 runs on course entry

name: sub_cgram_course
comment: MVN 512 bytes from pal_course to the $7E:0400 CGRAM staging buffer, then set $00A0 = 3

name: sub_cgram_course_backdrop
comment: 40 colours to CGRAM 0-39 for the per-course BG3 scenery; selects from tbl_backdrop_palette by course & 7

name: tbl_backdrop_palette
comment: 8 word addresses in bank $98, indexed by course & 7; 40 colours each

name: tbl_backdrop_palette_alt
comment: the variant taken when $7E:6A2E is non-zero

name: sub_load_course_backdrop
comment: load the per-course BG3 scenery; branches on $7E:ED5B, otherwise selects by course & 7

name: tbl_course_backdrop_tiles
comment: 8 entries x (bank16, addr16), indexed by course & 7; each decompresses to 3072 bytes to VRAM $4A00

name: tbl_course_backdrop_map
comment: 8 entries x (bank16, addr16), indexed by course & 7; each decompresses to a 32x32 tilemap to VRAM $3C00

name: dat_vram_records_backdrop_tiles
comment: one record: 3072 bytes from $7F:0000 to VRAM word $4A00

name: dat_vram_records_backdrop_tiles2
comment: second copy of the backdrop tile record, used by the course-indexed path

name: dat_vram_records_backdrop_alt
comment: 2048 bytes from $7F:0000 to VRAM word $4C00; the $7E:ED5B non-zero variant

name: dat_vram_records_backdrop_map
comment: one record: 2048 bytes from $7E:DADC to VRAM word $3C00, the backdrop tilemap

name: sub_course_palette
comment: A = $6A2E: entry 0 runs the course's list $80:D869[$6A5A] ($80:DA0D with $ED5B) through sub_cgram_list; entry 1 the alternate (not read); docs/courses.md "The palette in play"

name: tbl_course_palette_lists
comment: by course number: lists of 5 runs into BG palettes 2, 3, 5, 6, 7 from $98:DF64 + $120 * course; docs/courses.md

name: tbl_ball_gravity

name: tbl_roll_friction
comment: 22 ball modes x 4 classes, rolling friction per mode and surface class (mode 0: $0C00 flat, $07B0 slopes), indexed by $6A72

name: dat_bounce_min_frames
comment: $0010; below this many frames since the last bounce the ball comes to rest

name: dat_power_scale
comment: $1300; P = $1300 * tbl_power[meter] >> 14 (sub_shot_power)

name: dat_fly_spin_base
comment: $04AD; fly-shot spin scale K = 2 * (P/2 + P/4 + $04AD)

name: dat_roll_friction_default
comment: $0C00, to $DA2E/$DA3A at set-up

name: dat_bounce_damp_xy
comment: $7D6F (Q15 0.98): default vx/vy factor per bounce, to $DA30/$DA3C (emulated)

name: dat_bounce_damp_z
comment: $5332 (Q15 0.65): default vz factor per bounce, to $DA32/$DA3E at $80:C6B4 (emulated: $DA3E = $5332)

name: dat_step_damp
comment: $5332 (Q15 0.65): to $DA34/$DA40, the normal-component factor at a step hit

name: dat_step_damp_z
comment: $6665 (Q15 0.80): default vz factor when the ball hits a step in the air, to $DA36/$DA42 ($81:88DD)

name: tbl_spin_ground_tb
comment: signed bytes 96..-96 by 16: grounder top/back spin, P*v/256 into $D9CE; the selector never moves for a grounder, so always 0

name: tbl_curve
comment: signed bytes 42..-42 by 7: grounder curve, $D9CC = $4000 * v / 256 = 64v (emulated: 2 -> $0700)

name: tbl_spin_fly_side
comment: signed bytes -60..60 by 10: fly-shot side spin by $6B50 (emulated: 2 -> $D9CE = 707)

name: tbl_tile_friction
comment: coefficients the $20-$24 friction tiles write into $DA3A/$DA3C/$DA3E

name: tbl_kicker_clamp
comment: impulse clamp for the $10-$13 kicker tiles

name: tbl_tile_impulse
comment: impulse magnitudes for the $70-$7B toggled tiles

name: tbl_arrow_mode_land
comment: 22 words, one per ball mode: non-zero lets the arrow panels act on landing (2 in mode 0); $82:A6C7/$82:A70B

name: tbl_arrow_mode_hit
comment: 22 words, one per ball mode: the same gate for the rolling (hit-side) handlers $82:A74F/$82:A783

name: tbl_ability_hit_code_air
comment: copy ability -> hit code, ball in the air

name: tbl_ability_hit_code_ground
comment: copy ability -> hit code, ball on the ground

name: sub_thread_spawn
comment: A = object type: claim a slot, load entry and list from tbl_thread_types. JSL/RTL, returns the new slot in Y

name: sub_thread_exit
comment: free the running slot; reached by JML from 326 sites

name: sub_thread_yield
comment: A = frames to wait. Pops its own return address into ram_thr_resume_pc/bank, so the thread continues after the JSL. 2551 call sites

name: sub_thread_spawn_below
comment: spawn at X/Y from the stack, Y measured down from $8B9A; installs sub_obj2_draw_world

name: sub_thread_spawn_world
comment: spawn at world X/Y from the stack; installs sub_obj2_draw_world

name: sub_thread_spawn_screen
comment: spawn at screen X/Y from the stack; installs sub_obj2_draw_screen

name: sub_obj2_draw_world
comment: default draw: move, subtract the camera, look up table[index] and enqueue. JSL/RTL

name: sub_obj2_draw_screen
comment: default draw in screen coordinates; same table[index] lookup at $80:E5C5

name: sub_obj2_move
comment: add the velocities at $619C/$611C (and fractions) to the position

name: sub_obj2_enqueue
comment: JML target; second object system draw: screen-bounds check on X/Y, then JML $80:8B09 into sub_oam_enqueue with $C0 = ram_obj2_frame_ptr. Reached from $87:8C93, $87:932E, $87:98AA

name: sub_thread_helpers_install
comment: twelve MVNs copying dat_thread_helpers to ram_thread_helpers; called from the thread system reset at $80:DFB5

name: sub_obj2_motion_clear
comment: JSL, Y = slot: zeroes the motion fields $591C-$5D1C and $639C

name: sub_thread_clone
comment: spawn another object of the caller's own type with A in $589C and the caller's position; the body of the $1018 helper

name: sub_obj2_draw_world_moving
comment: draw routine: sub_obj2_motion, then sub_obj2_draw_world (object 62, the snap stars)

name: sub_obj2_draw_screen_moving
comment: draw routine: sub_obj2_motion, then sub_obj2_draw_screen

name: sub_obj2_motion
comment: the velocity from the motion fields: sub_polar(speed $5B1C, angle $5A1C hi) + ($591C,$599C) + sub_polar($5C9C, $5C1C hi), $5C9C += $5D1C; into $611C/$621C, $619C/$629C (docs/animation.md)

name: sub_polar
comment: JSR; A = r, X = angle 0-255: $00/$02 = ((r >> 6) * tbl_polar_cos[a] and [a + 64], low 16 bits) >> 2, arithmetic

name: sub_mul16_lo
comment: JSR; Y x A, the product's low 16 bits, from three 8x8 products of $4202/$4203

name: tbl_polar_cos
comment: 320 signed words, cos by angle 0-255 (256 = 1, $40 = up the screen) and the quarter turn sub_polar reads; not exact (T[63] = 2, T[319] = 0)

name: tbl_thread_types
comment: 234 object types x (entry addr16, bank8, list8). The highest type any spawn call passes is 233

name: sub_game_flow
comment: the game's top-level flow: title, members, map, course intro, holes, results, ending. See docs/emulation.md

name: tbl_dma_modes
comment: 16 x (DMAP, B-bus address, VMAIN), indexed by byte 0 of a VRAM record: $00 word copy, $03 fill, $1B copy stepping 32 words

name: sub_ball_physics_step
comment: JSL; one frame of ball physics for the object selected by $7E:180B

name: sub_tile_land
comment: dispatch the layer-2 byte in A through tbl_tile_on_land

name: tbl_tile_on_land
comment: 256 long pointers, indexed by the layer-2 byte; behaviour on landing

name: sub_tile_hit
comment: dispatch the layer-2 byte in A through tbl_tile_on_hit

name: tbl_tile_on_hit
comment: 256 long pointers; behaviour when the ball hits the cell from the side

name: sub_ball_save_prev
comment: JSL; copy $D9EC-$DA0B to $DA0C-$DA2B (previous-frame state)

name: sub_ball_restore_prev
comment: JSL; restore x, y, cell and probe fields from $DA10-$DA2B (not z, not velocity)

name: sub_ball_integrate_air
comment: JSL; x, y, z += velocity, then air drag on vx, vy: v -= (|v|+$80)>>8 toward 0, skipped in mode $0A (emulated)

name: sub_air_wall_hit
comment: JSL; airborne hit: wall flag -> sub_wall_bounce; else step -> sub_step_bounce, vz *= $DA42, clear spin, hit-stop; then gravity

name: sub_tile_none_land
comment: default on-land handler (112 tile values; JML target, RTL): the bounce when z < ground (loc_bounce), else gravity only

comment: the landing: z = ground, sub_reflect_surface($DA04), $DA4E = 1, hit-stop and sub_spin_impulse (modes 0/7), settle if $DA48 < $10 else damp (emulated)

name: loc_bounce_damp
comment: fall-through from loc_bounce: vx,vy *= $DA3C, vz *= $DA3E via sub_mul_q15s (Q15, toward 0), $DA48 = 0, then $81:899F adds gravity (emulated)

name: sub_check_fell_out
comment: world Z < -$110000: set $7E:D9D2 bit 0 and zero all three velocities

name: sub_ball_integrate
